  • Present data insights and performance indicators to internal stakeholders and clients in a clear and professional manner.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong digital literacy and interest in emerging technologies.

  • Collaboration and teamwork across departments.

  • Proactive attitude and ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Commitment to accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

jobDescriptionHtml:
Position Description


The Data Systems Analyst supports internal digital systems used for data collection, reporting, and business intelligence. Key responsibilities include monitoring incoming data, assisting with data quality processes, supporting mobile data collection tools, and helping develop dashboards and reports.

The role also contributes to continuous improvement of systems and workflows, including building or adapting digital forms, supporting deployments of new tools, and providing training to users.

This position suits someone with strong attention to detail, an inquisitive mindset, and a collaborative approach. The role involves a mix of office-based warehouse work and occasional field support.


Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Data management, monitoring and analysis

    • Monitor incoming data from field activities and troubleshoot issues. Alert supervisors of any key issues (mechanical data).

    • Ensure data is clean and usable for analysis, and follow up with the team to resolve mechanical data issues present in the data.

    • Develop and follow prescribed workflows for data revisions.

    • Report on data variables as requested.

    • Identify user issues through data monitoring and analysis activities and retrain as necessary to avoid repeated problems.

  • Assist with development and maintenance of mobile data collection forms and internal dashboards
    Ensure all support material for apps and dashboards is developed.

    • Assist users with device and data collection troubleshooting in the field.

    • Support internal business intelligence systems and reporting platforms

    • Assist with testing and rollout of new digital tools

  • Support the deployment of digital data collection apps 

    • Train users on new apps and forms to ensure data collected is clear and free from errors.

    • Field visits may be required where new apps are deployed.

    • Conduct internal testing for new data collection apps and forms as needed.

    • Create training materials for capacity building activities in mobile data collection.

    • Conduct data collection and training/retraining for the field team in the Standard Operating Procedures in relation to app use, data collection and management.

  • IT mentoring and communication

    • Act as a technical mentor for other staff working with mobile devices and/or data.

About the Role

We are looking for a Digital Transfonnation Specialist to spearhead the modernization of our Midea Indonesia Sales

BU operations in Indonesia. This role combines leadership in digitalization with practical IT operations management ensuring our business is supported today while being transformed for tomorrow.

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities for digital transformation, working closely with regional and HQ teams to design solutions, and the execution of digitalization initiatives. At the same time, you will manage the local IT team, ensuring stable day- to- day operations.

  • Strong knowledge of CRM, ERP, Analytics, and e- commerce ecosystems with ability to connect business needs to technology solutions.

  • Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across all reporting platforms.

  • Develop standardized templates and tools for project data submission and tracking.

  • Present data insights and performance indicators to internal stakeholders and clients in a clear and professional manner.

  • Automate recurring reports and develop interactive visual tools to support decision-making.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for ongoing projects.

  • Provide data-driven recommendations to improve operational effectiveness and client satisfaction.

  • Support management reviews and client presentations with up-to-date performance data.

5. Compliance and Documentation

  • Maintain proper documentation of data sources, methodologies, and dashboards.

  • Ensure compliance with company data governance, confidentiality, and security policies.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Proven experience (2–4 years) in data management, business intelligence, or digital transformation roles.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, Excel (advanced), and data visualization tools.

  • Familiarity with databases, data cleaning, and integration tools (e.g., SQL, SharePoint, Power Automate) is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities for both internal and client-facing reporting.

Core Competencies:

  • Data-driven mindset and analytical approach.

  • Strong digital literacy and interest in emerging technologies.

  • Collaboration and teamwork across departments.

  • Proactive attitude and ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Commitment to accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.
